name: Fighting retreats
description: Gameplay change: a fleet that notices the fight has turned against it (less firepower than the enemies it is fighting) falls back together (to its home base or the nearest own system; to the nearest repair yard when more than a set share of it is damaged) instead of fighting to the end, then goes back to its duties (automated) or waits for orders. Ships keep the original's per-design Flee setting; a fleet whose ships are set to Flee: never does not withdraw. Set on the new-game wizard's Other Empires page.

params.name: frCheckSeconds
params.label: Check battles every this many game seconds

params.name: frOutgunned
params.label: A fleet withdraws when the enemy in its battle has this many times its firepower

params.name: frHoldSeconds
params.label: A losing fleet withdraws after this many game seconds

params.name: frHysteresis
params.label: A losing fleet stops counting down once its firepower is back above this % of the losing line

params.name: frDamagedPct
params.label: A withdrawing fleet goes to a repair yard only when more than this % of its ships in the battle are damaged (else it falls back)
